title: An Online EPM for Estimating Intermediate AutoML Solutions (EDCA)
summary: EDCA is a low-cost, genetic-algorithm-driven AutoML framework that searches for efficient machine learning pipelines given a classification dataset. Its model.py contains a commented-out block that would instantiate SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer for data augmentation, but this code path is inactive, so SDV is only nominally referenced via a requirements.txt pin and dead code.
evidence: edca/edca/model.py:139-144, entire SDV synthesizer instantiation block is commented out with '#' prefixes
needs: SDV usage code is fully commented out; unclear whether it was ever active or is a stale/incomplete integration attempt.
